identificationModule.briefTitle: First-line Treatment With RC48 Plus Sintilimab and S-1 in Advanced Gastric Cancer (RCTS2)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II, Open-Label, Multicenter Trial Comparing Disitamab Vedotin Plus Sintilimab and S-1 With Trastuzumab Plus Chemotherapy ± Sintilimab for First-Line Treatment of HER2-Positive Advanced Gastric or Gastroesophageal Junction Adenocarcinoma (RCTS2)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a Phase II, randomized, multicenter, open-label clinical trial designed to compare Disitamab Vedotin plus Sintilimab and S-1 with Trastuzumab plus chemotherapy ± Sintilimab for first-line treatment of HER2-Positive advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.

interventions.name: S-1
interventions.description: 40-60 mg BID for 14 days, every 3 weeks

interventions.name: Trastuzumab
interventions.description: First load dose is 8.0mg/kg , then 6.0 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks

primaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of subjects with complete response (CR) and partial response (PR) in total subjects
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 6 months after the last subject participating in

secondaryOutcomes.description: Progression-free survival (PFS) refers to the time from the date of randomization to the first researcher's evaluation of disease progression or death (calculated by the event that occurred first). The disease progression will be evaluated by the researchers according to the RECIST 1.1 standard.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 12 months after the last subject participating in

secondaryOutcomes.description: Overall survival (OS) refers to the time from the date of randomization to the date of death of the subject.

secondaryOutcomes.description: DOR is defined as the time from the first documented objective response (CR or PR) to the first documented disease progression or death
